mapper.select: SELECT tdm40_company_id FROM tdm40_manl_job WHERE tdm40_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId}
mapper.sql: SELECT tdm40_manl_job_id AS manl_job_id, tdm40_company_id AS company_id, TO_CHAR(tdm40_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date, tdm40_job_nm AS job_name, TO_CHAR(tdm40_manl_apply_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS manl_apply_start_date, tdm40_role_id AS role_id, tdm20_role_nm AS role_name, tdm40_org_id AS org_id, org00_kor_nm AS org_name, tdm40_job_reason AS job_reason, TO_CHAR(tdm40_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(tdm40_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, CASE WHEN tdm41_manl_job_id IS NULL THEN '미생성' ELSE tdm41_end_cnt ||'/'|| tdm41_org_cnt END AS duty_cnt_str, CASE WHEN tdm41_end_cnt = tdm41_org_cnt AND tdm41_end_cnt != 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS duty_end_yn, TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN tdm41_end_cnt = tdm41_org_cnt AND tdm41_end_cnt != 0 THEN tdm41_end_date ELSE null END, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS duty_end_date, tdm40_upd_nm AS upd_name, COALESCE(TO_CHAR(tdm40_upd_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), '') AS upd_date_str FROM tdm40_manl_job LEFT JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm40_role_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL getOrg(tdm40_company_id, tdm40_reg_date) ON org00_org_id = tdm40_org_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tdm41_manl_job_id , COUNT(DISTINCT tdm44_org_id) tdm41_org_cnt , SUM(tdm44_end_cnt) tdm41_end_cnt , MAX(tdm44_end_date) tdm41_end_date FROM ( SELECT tdm41_manl_job_id , tdm44_org_id , CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN tdm44_end_yn = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END tdm44_end_cnt , MAX(tdm44_end_date) tdm44_end_date FROM tdm41_manl_duty LEFT JOIN tdm44_manl_duty_org ON tdm44_manl_duty_id = tdm41_manl_duty_id WHERE tdm41_manl_job_id = tdm40_manl_job_id GROUP BY tdm41_manl_job_id, tdm44_org_id ) t GROUP BY tdm41_manl_job_id ) tdm41 ON TRUE
mapper.select:
WHERE tdm40_company_id = #{companyId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm42_manl_org WHERE tdm42_manl_job_id = tdm40_manl_job_id AND tdm42_org_id = f_get_tdmOrg_id2(tdm40_company_id, #{orgId}, f_today()) ) AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm42_manl_org WHERE 1=1 AND tdm42_manl_job_id = tdm40_manl_job_id ) > 0
AND ( tdm41_org_cnt IS NULL OR tdm41_org_cnt = 0 OR tdm41_org_cnt != tdm41_end_cnt )
AND tdm41_manl_job_id IS NOT NULL
AND CONCAT(tdm40_job_nm, tdm20_role_nm) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY tdm40_reg_date DESC, tdm40_manl_job_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm40_manl_job ( tdm40_manl_job_id, tdm40_company_id, tdm40_reg_date, tdm40_job_nm, tdm40_manl_apply_start_date , tdm40_role_id, tdm40_org_id, tdm40_job_reason, tdm40_start_date, tdm40_end_date , tdm40_upd_nm, tdm40_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{manlJobId}, #{companyId}, #{regDate}, #{jobName}, #{manlApplyStartDate} , #{roleId}, #{orgId}, #{jobReason}, #{startDate}, #{endDate} , #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm41_manl_duty INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm41_role_id INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON tdm10_task_id = tdm41_task_id WHERE tdm41_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm42_manl_org INNER JOIN tdm43_manl ON tdm43_manl_org_id = tdm42_manl_org_id WHERE tdm42_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tdm43_manl WHERE tdm43_manl_org_id IN ( SELECT tdm42_manl_org_id FROM tdm42_manl_org WHERE tdm42_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId} )
DELETE FROM tdm44_manl_duty_org WHERE tdm44_manl_duty_id IN ( SELECT tdm41_manl_duty_id FROM tdm41_manl_duty WHERE tdm41_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm44_manl_duty_org SELECT f_create_seq() , tdm41_manl_duty_id , #{orgId} , 'false' , null , null , #{updName} , f_sysdate() FROM tdm41_manl_duty WHERE tdm41_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId}
mapper.select: SELECT f_create_tdm_manual(#{jobType}, #{companyId}, #{manlJobId}) FROM (SELECT set_config('app.current_user', #{updName}, true)) s
